custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at a location that has no bin location named Unassigned.
    • How to do it: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Locations in the left menu, then New Location; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573682 LOCATION NEW in Name * and click Save & Close. To switch to it: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it. Then Settings, Bin Locations in the left menu: the list must not show Unassigned.
  • Use part numbers for two new parts, part A and part B, that no part or Part Library entry uses yet.
  • Have a parts import file with two rows that add part A and part B, each with quantity 0 and an empty bin location cell.
    • How to do it: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu; click Download Template, open the file in a spreadsheet program, add two rows with part_number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573682-A and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573682-B, a name, quantity 0 and the grid_location cell left empty, and save it as a CSV file.
  • Start on that location's Inventory data import page (click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu; the page is titled Inventory Import Preview).
